messages:
mina: Quick weekly release-train bulletin — please read.

mina: TL;DR: sprint cutover is tomorrow 09:00 UTC. We’re enabling a 2-hour embargo window for high-risk changes, and a Priority Reservation pool for Dedicated capacity to support customer-bound rollouts.

mina: Key actions:
- No non-critical merges to main during embargo (09:00–11:00 UTC)
- If you need an exemption, request here: @eng-leads with rationale + risk plan
- Reservation pool: contact infra-allocs to pin GPUs (quota limited)

devon: Quick q — how do teams request a reservation? any form/PR required?

alex: Reservation flow: open infra-allocs ticket, include customer name, expected qps, time window. Infra will ack and attach reservation id. Keep requests <= 4h by default.

sasha: Canary note — observed a +30ms p95 bump on `redwood-v2-small` at 03:20 UTC during last canary. We retoggled the model to previous weights; rollout paused. Monitoring is on.

release-bot: Canary report: model redwood-v2-small — canary_2026-03-22-03:20 — p95 +30ms, error-rate unchanged. Rollout status: paused, rollback applied automatically.

eng-oncall-bot: Alert suppressed (incident 6861). Oncall assigned: @devon.

devon: I'll run the micro-bench and compare kernel traces. If it's a kernel selection issue we'll hotfix the scheduling policy. ETA 2h.

sasha: Also verifying KV cache warmup stats — might be a rollout interaction with caching heuristics.

mina: Heads-up: if your change touches runtime scheduling, batching, or quant kernels, please block merges until we validate. If you have an urgent rollback exception, ping me or @alex.

alex: For release owners: update the changelog doc (internal) with any reservation ids and canary observations before cutover.

devon: Noted. I'll post a quick readout in this thread after the micro-bench.

mina: Final: weekly changelog link: https://redwood.internal/releases/weekly-logs — add your PR summaries. Thanks :thumbsup:
